items.prompt: A bus with 58 seats starts empty. At the first stop 27 people get on. At the next stop 14 get off and 19 get on. How many seats are empty now?
hints: Work out how many people are on the bus.
items.explanation: 27 - 14 = 13, and 13 + 19 = 32 people are on the bus. 58 - 32 = 26 seats are empty.
